units: Metric values are proportions, not percentages; counts are integers.
aggregation_note: Task rows pool counts. english_macro rows average the four task metrics, including F-scores; their pooled_counts are support counts, not the formula inputs for macro scores. overall rows pool all task counts.

metric_definitions.strict_unit: exact start character, end character and label
